tuition.quote: listed in Annexes 1, 2 and 3 of the ARES circular: €1,194

worker_notes: The EUR 1,194 figure applies to non-EU nationals from countries exempt from the additional fee (ARES circular Annexes 1 to 3). Non-EU nationals from other countries pay EUR 1,194 plus EUR 4,175 in additional fees; that higher amount is not reported as a maximum because the page gives no total. This is the fee for 2026-2027 registration of non-assimilated students of non-European nationality; continuing students keep the previous system. No English test minimum or deadline checked.
